description: Persist a durable fact, project rule, or user preference, automatically deduplicating paraphrases and superseding contradicted older 1:1 claims while preserving 1:N additive facts. Use for standing truths; use `oxyo_remember_episode` for transient chronological events.

claim.description: Single self-contained factual statement, configuration rule, or user preference.

confidence.description: Epistemic certainty score from 0.0 (tentative) to 1.0 (verified ground truth).

force_supersede.description: Explicitly override high-confidence belief revision protection when replacing a verified rule.

scope.description: Project/repo scope for conflict resolution and recall (defaults to 'global').

witness.description: Optional verification evidence or source citation required when revising a high-confidence (>=0.95) standing belief.

name: oxyo_remember_belief
